final: SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, rating_avg_fee_per_day, rating_avg_fee_per_day / overall_avg_fee_per_day AS ratio_to_overall FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS rating_avg_fee_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS by_rating CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(rating_avg_fee_per_day) AS overall_avg_fee_per_day FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS rating_avg_fee_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating)) AS overall WHERE overall_avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL AND rating_avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL
